subject: general
question: Who among the following is known as Sarangi instrumentalist?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ustad Bundu Khan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Ustad Binda Khan was the **maestro of Sarangi.**
 
• Sarangi has a **hollow body and is made of teak wood** adorned with ivory inlays.
 
• Bundu Khan played the sarangi from** ****All India Radio****,** Delhi Station when it first started** broadcasting in 1935.**
 
• He served the **princely court of ****Indore**** for 27 years **as a court musician.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f71d9908de1674568bc985c7a71e6d8e98b76c7f0d6bebb06a94660c3c86483.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trippunithura Narayanaiyer Krishnan** was an Indian Carnatic music violinist. ​ 
 
• **Thanjavur** Brinda (1912-1996) was one of the representatives of the Veenai Dhanammal school of Carnatic Music. 
 
• **Thodur Madabusi Krishna** is an Indian **Carnatic vocalist**,** writer, activist, author and Ramon Magsaysay awardee.**
